report.question: Implementation target: convert each prose reproduction recipe into a runnable script with a deterministic exit code. Question: what fraction of recipes cannot be mechanised, and for each one which step requires human judgement? A recipe that cannot be mechanised is a documentation defect that will silently rot, and it is filed as such.

prose_steps: Copy the reporter's one-liner into the shell tool: python3 -c 'print("can't")'.
The command is inlined into the tool's own quoting.
Observe whether the print runs or the apostrophe terminates the quoted command early.
Open 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.md and collect every family-M token of the form M-NN.
Open 13-ARCHITECTURE-CANDIDATES.md and collect every mechanism token of the form M-NN.
The defect is live if and only if the intersection size is 31.
Run the tool with --dry-run against the sample input.
Confirm sidecar.json is absent from the output directory after the dry-run.
